scope.excluded: No broader notes, findings, decisions, incident records, preregistration documents, candidate-authoring note, or experiment results were read or used.
scope.comparison_unit: Conversation message role/content pairs were compared by zero-based message index. Non-message conversation fields were compared structurally. A counterfactual was considered to establish an answer only when the history identifies that answer as the user's selected option or intended in-chat sense; merely listing it as an unselected option or the other overloaded sense does not establish it as the probe answer.
scope.verdict_constraint: No candidate can PASS because the committed blind naturalness/coherence review failed all four. This audit therefore assigns only REVISE or REJECT.

hash_method.raw_file_sha256: SHA-256 over the exact committed file bytes
hash_method.canonical_sha256: SHA-256 over UTF-8 JSON serialized with sorted object keys, ensure_ascii=false, and separators ',' and ':'

global_diff_findings.observed: For every candidate, the only message role/content differences from its exact base are the indices recorded in changed_message_allowlist; no roles differ. Conversation id, title, sections, plants, and meta are structurally identical to the base. Thus every non-allowlisted message, both selected plant rows, all other plant rows, and every unrelated factual chain are unchanged by the candidate diff.
global_diff_findings.important_qualification: Byte/structural identity proves that an unrelated chain was not altered by the counterfactual edit; it does not prove that the inherited chain is factually sound or conversationally complete. The blind review identified several defects that are present identically in the base and candidate.
global_diff_findings.paired_repair_rule: Repairs to inherited, non-focal defects must be made identically in a newly rendered correct/counterfactual pair. Repairing only the candidate would introduce non-focal differences and invalidate the matched comparison. All revised pairs require fresh hashes and fresh mechanical validation.

overall_summary: All four candidates make the frozen counterfactual probe answer recoverable and stop identifying the frozen correct answer as the user's final selection or intended in-chat sense. None establishes exactly and only the frozen counterfactual: c02-referent invents a selection rationale; c02-sense invents lounge operations and retains a 'Beacon session' type cue; c10-referent transfers a scheme-2 location and leaves an island reference; c10-sense introduces a direct deck location/bundling contradiction and extra closet scope. Every candidate also inherits the blind-review failures from its base. Each swap is nevertheless locally repairable, so all four are REVISE rather than REJECT. No artifact is execution-ready, and inherited repairs must be made symmetrically in newly rendered correct/counterfactual pairs.
